decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed raising of the existing pitched roof to create a flat roof on the existing rear extension incorporating extended balustrade, because of its position, design and appearance, would be compatible with the listed building and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the surrounding properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with The London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003).
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before theextension is occupied.
description: Removal of existing pitched roof to single storey rear extension and extension of flat roof incorporating extended balustrade.
